Initializes the compression context with the parsed preferences; sets cctxPtr->blockCompression = LZ4B_COMPRESSED and computes blockSize=65536 for LZ4F_max64KB.

Calls uncompressedUpdate with 1000 bytes of uninitialized data; since cctxPtr->blockCompression (LZ4B_COMPRESSED) differs from LZ4B_UNCOMPRESSED, it first flushes the 897-byte tmpIn buffer, then sets blockCompression=LZ4B_UNCOMPRESSED and copies all 1000 uninitialized bytes into tmpIn (tmpInSize=1000) because 1000 < 65536.
